units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:10">B. Mets. IV, 10</cite> <he>בכמה ח׳ זה</he> how much is this worth? <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:8">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>כל ח׳ טוב</he> any good thing; a. fr.

senses.gloss: concern, business; desire, desirable object. Ib.; Pesik. Sos, p. 147ᵃ אין לי ח׳ טוב ממך I have nothing more desirable than thyself.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:7">Koh. R. to V, 7</cite> <he>נעשה חֶפְצוֹ</he> his desire was fulfilled.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:15">Num. R. s. 19</cite> <he>אל תחזירני מן חֶפְצִי וכ׳</he> do not turn me off from (refuse) my desire which &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲפָצִים</he>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 9b:2">M. Kat. 9ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 3:15">Prov. III, 15</cite>, a.
<cite ref="Proverbs 8:11">VIII, 11</cite>) <he>הא חֶפְצֵי שמים</he> but heavenly affairs (religious deeds) are equal to it (the study of the Law).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:36">Y. Peah I, 15ᵈ</cite> bot. (ref. to Prov. l. c.) <he>חפצים וכ׳</he> ‘desirable things’, that means jewels and pearls, ‘thy desirable things’, that means &c. Ib. <he>חֲפָצֶיךָ וחֲפָצַי וכ׳</he> thy treasures and my treasures cannot compare to what I sent you; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 35:3">Gen. R. s. 35</cite>, end.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 113a:14">Sabb. 113ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 58:13">Is. LVIII, 13</cite>) <he>חֲפָצֶיךָ אסורין ח׳ שמים וכ׳</he> thy pursuits are forbidden (on the Sabbath), but heavenly affairs (consultation about public welfare, education &c.) are permitted; ib. 150ᵃ; a. fr.
